name: Twice Baked Russet Potatoes with Bacon, Cheddar & Chives

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry potatoes. Prick all over with a fork, then transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until potatoes are tender, so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, about 1 hour.
When the potatoes are done, remove from the oven. Set aside until cool enough to handle, 10-15 minutes.
While the potatoes are cooling, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, small dice bacon.
Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 4-5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove crispy bacon to a paper towel-lined plate; set aside.

When the potatoes are cool enough to handle, slice in half lengthwise and carefully scoop the flesh into a medium bowl, leaving about 1/4-inch of potato attached to the skins. Coat the baking sheet with a thin layer of oil and return potato skins, cut-side up, to the pan.

Add half of the grated cheese, sour cream, milk, butter, salt, and pepper to the bowl with potato. Using a potato masher, mash until smooth and combined. Spoon the mixture back into the reserved potato skins, then top with remaining cheese.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup sour cream
59 ml whole milk
1 tbsp butter, unsalted
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Return baking sheet to the oven and bake the potatoes until filling is warm and cheese is melted, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and using a clean cutting board, mince chives.
To serve, transfer potatoes to a serving platter; top with bacon and chives. Enjoy!
